description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Topiary Lecturer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat.

uses.name: Topiary Lecturer
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
